en: The Heart Dhāraṇī of the Avataṃsaka Sūtra: Oṃ jina jina tathāgatadhṛtipraveśanidhiprati uttamodame oṃ svasti te sarvathā.
This dhāraṇī was spoken by the Tathāgata Samantabhadra.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda of Khotan.
There is another version of the sutra which states:
If a person recites this once,
it is equivalent to reciting the three versions— the upper, middle, and lower— of the Avataṃsaka Sūtra from the Chinese Tripitaka once;
how much more so if one constantly maintains it.
If one can complete one hundred thousand recitations,
that person will become quick-witted and discerning regarding subtle matters,
penetrating all the treasuries of the teachings.
As for the accumulation of merit and the transformation of obstacles, they cannot be fully described.
Bestowed by Master Mahāyāna of Gaogong Temple in Shangyuan County.
